# ezghcloud_kubernetes_node_group (Resource)

A node group: a cluster's nodes, instances of one type on one autoscaling group. Cluster Autoscaler sizes it between min_size and max_size. Up to 100 nodes, 110 pods per node.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_id` (String) Node Bot (bot_), the nodes' Instance Bot. Needs KubernetesNodeAccess, and the cluster's Bot needs bots.pass on it. Changing it replaces the node group.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster (kcl_). Changing it replaces the node group.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type of the nodes. Changing it replaces the node group.
- `max_size` (Number) Most nodes, 1 to 100.
- `min_size` (Number) Fewest nodes, 0 to 100.
- `name` (String) Node group name. Changing it replaces the node group.
- `project_id` (String) The cluster's project. Changing it replaces the node group.
- `subnet_id` (String) Private subnet (sbn_) in the cluster's VPC. Changing it replaces the node group.

### Optional

- `desired_size` (Number) Nodes to start with. Left out, min_size. Only applies at create: Cluster Autoscaler owns the size after that, so it's never drift.
- `labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels on each node.
- `max_unavailable_percent` (Number) Most nodes replaced at once during an upgrade, as a percentage. Left out, 25.
- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for each asynchronous operation, for example 30m.
- `root_volume_size_gib` (Number) Root volume size of each node in GiB. Changing it replaces the node group.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of String) SSH keys (ssh_) on each node, at most 10. Changing them replaces the node group.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
- `taints` (Attributes List) Kubernetes taints on each node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--taints))
- `version` (String) Kubernetes minor version of the nodes, at most the cluster's. Left out, the cluster's. Changing it replaces the nodes a few at a time, each drained first.

### Read-Only

- `autoscaling_group_id` (String) The node group's autoscaling group (asg_). Changes made to it directly are replaced by the node group.
- `id` (String) Node group ID (kng_).
- `operation_id` (String) Most recent operation initiated by this resource; unavailable on import.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) What the node group is doing: creating, active, updating, deleting or failed.

<a id="nestedatt--taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `taints`

Required:

- `effect` (String) NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule or NoExecute.
- `key` (String) Taint key.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Taint value; empty for none.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_kubernetes_node_group.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/CLUSTER_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
